problem_class.label: other
problem_class.details: Bounded mixed-integer linear optimization: minimize cᵀz+dᵀy subject to Az+Gy≤b, z∈ℤᵖ, lo≤z≤hi, and y∈ℝᑫ. The objective is linear; integrality makes the feasible domain generally nonconvex.

oracle.label: other
oracle.details: Exact box-restricted LP optimization oracle. A query supplies integer lower and upper bounds; the reply is an optimal continuous relaxation point or none certifying infeasibility. Correctness holds for every history and seed; arbitrary optimal-point selection is permitted. Each complete LP query counts as one oracle call.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HiddenMixedIntegerLinear.lean: spec.Query, spec.Reply, spec.admissible; LongTails/Setups/BoundedMixedIntegerLinear.lean: IsRelaxationOracle, SolvesRelaxation, RelaxationFeasible.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: Integer variables lie in ℤᵖ and continuous variables in ℝᑫ, with finitely many linear inequalities. Integer coordinates have public finite bounds; continuous coordinates need not be bounded.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Only p, q, c, d, lo, hi are public. The constraint count m, matrices A and G, right-hand side b, and certificate λ are hidden. Validity requires either λ≥0 and d+λᵀG=0, or infeasibility of the initial continuous relaxation. The extracted budget depends on the hidden cardinality of goodPoints, whose Lagrangian values are lower bounds on every mixed-feasible objective value.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HiddenMixedIntegerLinear.lean: Public, Params, spec.publicInput, spec.valid, lagrangian, goodPoints; supplied OracleTemplate.HiddenMixedIntegerLinear.result budget.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Exact global optimality: a returned solution must be mixed-feasible and have objective no larger than every mixed-feasible solution. No positive epsilon tolerance is present.

accuracy.label: feasibility
accuracy.details: Return an exact feasible optimizer, or none only when no mixed-feasible solution exists.

accuracy.label: deterministic
accuracy.details: Success is required for every outcome ω, including every algorithm and oracle seed, rather than merely in expectation or almost surely.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The underlying optimization problem is standard MILP, but hidden constraints accessed exclusively through an exact box-relaxation oracle, together with a hidden-certificate-dependent call budget, create an unusual information and complexity model.
